text:
Nina K.: FYI: shifting next release train by 12 hours to avoid clash with planned storage cluster maintenance. This is a one-off shift; please surface any active rollouts or migrations.
Ethan W.: noted. new window when?
Nina K.: new windows: Thu 2026-06-10 18:00-23:59 UTC (primary) and Fri 2026-06-11 08:00-12:00 UTC (contingency). Original window was Fri night.
Sasha V.: propose temporary rule: no schema migrations that alter partitioning or routing during these windows. Small index-only changes ok with review.
release-leads: agreed. adding an approval gate: migrations touching routing require explicit release-leads + infra signoff.
ops-bot: maintenance_notice: storage-cluster: region us-central-1, 2026-06-11T02:00:00Z -> 2026-06-11T06:00:00Z. Impact: increased I/O latency during window; planned failover testing.
QA-team: QA will run the core smoke + perf baseline after each rollout during the shifted window. Please attach smoke logs to the release PR.
Nina K.: temporary canary cap: max 3% traffic for any canary that touches model-serving, and auto-pause on >1.2% error uplift over baseline for 7 minutes. Ops will force rollback if no owner action within 10 minutes.
Ethan W.: can you paste the config snippet for the auto-pause?
Sasha V.: snippet below (ops will apply centrally): ```json
{"canary": {"max_percent": 3, "error_uplift_pct": 1.2, "window_mins": 7, "escalation_mins": 10}}
```
release-leads: also adding mandatory PR labels: `release.owner` and `release.rollback-plan` or we won't approve scheduling.
Nina K.: if you have long-lived experiments or traffic shaping in place, mark them here. We need a list by EOD so scheduling can be finalized.
Ethan W.: I have an embeddings model canary running at 1% with no binary changes. Will cap to 0.5% during the storage maintenance window.
QA-team: we'll post the smoke run results in this thread. If any rollout touches routing tables, please file an RFC in #eng-releases with rollback steps.
Nina K.: final: expect a short summary doc and a pinned note in #eng-notices in 30m. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
